drafts.lead: Tony, Vetttd (Emily) - asked about the sending domain
drafts.body:
Hi Tony,

Fair question. The outreach goes out on rotating sending domains for deliverability, so growthoraq.co won't have a site behind it. But here's the company itself: [Koldify](https://koldify.io).

Happy to hop on a quick call and walk you through how it all works.

Emily

drafts.lead: Vivek, Proton DataLabs — offered Tue/Wed 10am PST conditional on us having direct access to ops/supply chain/data leaders
drafts.body:
Vivek,

Straight answer on the condition, because it decides whether the call is worth your time.

We do not have standing access to those people. We are not sitting on relationships with operations and supply chain leaders that we hand over. What we do is build the list of them, run outreach in your name from separate sending infrastructure, and the ones who are actually trying to move AI and analytics into operating decisions reply directly to you.

So it is access we create rather than access we own. If what you need is a warm rolodex, we are not it, and I would rather say that now than on the call.

If building that channel is still interesting, 10 AM PST Tuesday or Wednesday both work. Tell me which and I will send the invite.

Alice

Good. Here is what is open:

Madison
